overview: The Farayi Malek Quintet performed a live set of original compositions, bluegrass-influenced tracks, and classic jazz standards at the Medford Jazz Fest.

items.title: Introduction
items.summary: Terry Carter introduced the members of the Farayi Malek Quintet and highlighted their musical backgrounds.

items.title: Performance of 'Every Heartbeat'
items.summary: Farayi Malek introduced and performed her single 'Every Heartbeat'.

items.title: Performance of 'In Her Closet'
items.summary: The band performed 'In Her Closet', a song about self-acceptance from Malek's debut EP.

items.title: Performance of 'Today is Not My Day'
items.summary: Malek introduced and performed 'Today is Not My Day', an original song inspired by traditional jazz standards.

items.title: Performance of 'Going Home to the Rockies'
items.summary: The band performed 'Going Home to the Rockies', an original song about Malek's home state of Idaho.

items.title: Performance of 'Prayer for the People'
items.summary: The band performed Malek's latest collaborative single, 'Prayer for the People'.

items.title: Performance of Gospel Hymn
items.summary: The band performed a gospel-themed selection featuring a traditional hymn.

items.title: Performance of 'May A Love Like This Find Me'
items.summary: Malek introduced and performed 'May A Love Like This Find Me', a song exploring different types of love in community and family.

items.title: Performance of 'Sunny Side of the Street'
items.summary: The quintet performed a rendition of the classic jazz standard 'Sunny Side of the Street'.

items.title: Performances of 'Caught in a Storm' and 'Where Flowers Grow'
items.summary: The band closed their scheduled set with 'Caught in a Storm' and performed 'Where Flowers Grow' as an encore.

items.title: Closing Remarks and Intermission
items.summary: Terry Carter thanked the performers, recognized the individual band members, and announced a brief intermission before the next act.
